lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial slits. The spots are arranged in a repeating grid-like pattern with roughly 4-5 spots per vertical column, maintaining consistent relative spacing between local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid of anchor nodes along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from a light dorsal edge to a darker ventral shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, labyrinthine or vermicular pattern of high-luminance sinuous lines is present on the dorsal-lateral surface of the head and neck region, anterior to the gill slits.
